name: exercise-put
description: Exercise a filled put you hold before expiry: deliver the tokens and receive the strike in WETH minus the 0.1% fee. Approve the PutMarket for amount of the token first.

inputs.name: id
inputs.description: Option id (the OptionNFT token id). Read it from kyte.sh/market, the Kyte MCP (find_offers, get_positions) or the OfferCreated event.
